description: This file defines the KpiSearchController class, a controller for handling KPI search functionality within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component named 'kpi-search' in the preRender method.

classes.name: KpiSearchController
classes.description: Controller for KPI search functionality, extending the AbstractVueController and setting up the 'kpi-search' Vue component during pre-rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the 'kpi-search' Vue component before rendering the view, accepting a Request object.
